components.name: Protection Dispatch Banner
components.description: Top status card with MONDAFONE header bar, [ ACTIVE GUARD ] stamp, geometric shield/P2P emblem, and live stage/peer metrics.
components.html:
MONDAFONE[ ACTIVE GUARD ]
[#]
The end of spam calls
Stages: 4/4 · P2P nodes: 2
components.css: .ds-banner { background: #FAF6EE; color: #141A1F; border: 2px solid #141A1F; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #141A1F; font-family: sans-serif; } .ds-banner-head { background: #F2ECE1; border-bottom: 2px solid #141A1F; padding: 6px 10px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; } .ds-stamp { background: #5A9E7C; border: 2px solid #141A1F; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 10px; } .ds-banner-body { padding: 10px; display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; } .ds-emblem { width: 40px; height: 40px; background: #5A9E7C; border: 2px solid #141A1F; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 700; } .ds-hl { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-sub { font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Readiness Stage Cell
components.description: 48dp interactive permission stage cell with semantic top band and press-collapse shadow.
components.css: .ds-stage { width: 72px; height: 48px; background: #FAF6EE; color: #141A1F; border: 2px solid #141A1F; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #141A1F; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; cursor: pointer; } .ds-stage-band { width: 100%; height: 6px; background: #5A9E7C; border-bottom: 2px solid #141A1F; } .ds-stage-code { font-family: monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-stage-lbl { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; padding-bottom: 4px; } .ds-stage:active { transform: translate(3px, 3px); box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Signal Sage machine key for affirmative/safe actions; 48dp high, depresses into its 4dp shadow on press.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #5A9E7C; color: #141A1F; border: 2px solid #141A1F; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #141A1F; height: 48px; padding: 0 12px; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translate(4px, 4px); box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Verdict Ticket Row

components.css: .ds-ticket { background: #F2ECE1; color: #141A1F; border: 2px solid #141A1F; } .ds-ticket-band { height: 6px; background: #E0AC40; border-bottom: 2px solid #141A1F; } .ds-ticket-body { padding: 10px 12px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-ticket-num { font-family: monospace; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-ticket-sub { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 12px; } .ds-ticket-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-tbtn { height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 2px solid #141A1F; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #141A1F; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tbtn-danger { background: #D46F5A; } .ds-tbtn-safe { background: #5A9E7C; } .ds-tbtn:active { transform: translate(3px, 3px); box-shadow: none; }

narrative.northStar: The Neighborhood Watch Dispatch (Boletín de Guardia Vecinal)
narrative.overview: Mondafone looks like an official civil-defense and neighborhood-watch protection bulletin printed on warm bone stock: stamped status headers, a geometric Canvas shield-and-node emblem, semantic color bands across every module, and hard architectural offset shadows in deep navy-charcoal ink.
keyCharacteristics: Warm Bone Paper ground (#F2ECE1) with Bright Dispatch Card Stock (#FAF6EE) and 2dp Navy-Charcoal Ink (#141A1F) borders.
Top semantic color bands (6dp–10dp high, framed by a 2dp horizontal ink rule) on stat tiles, readiness cells, ticket rows, and prompt cards.
Stamped Protection Banner pairing MONDAFONE with a live [ ACTIVE GUARD ] / [ SETUP REQUIRED ] stamp and a 45°/90° geometric Canvas shield/P2P emblem.
4-stage horizontal Readiness Strip tracking FILTER, ALERTS, BLE NET, and POWER with 48dp touch targets and press-collapse physics.
Slotted dispatch ticket rows with top semantic bands, > number monospace headers, inline classification prompt subtitles, and 48dp-touch-target compact keys.

rules.name: The Semantic Top-Band Rule
rules.body: Every stat tile, readiness stage cell, verdict ticket row, and prompt card carries a horizontal top band (6dp–8dp high, closed by a 2dp ink line) colored by its semantic role.

rules.name: The Hatch-Plus-Hue Rule
rules.body: Pending permission stages and empty states never rely on color alone: their top band draws 45° diagonal ink hatch lines across the band.

rules.name: The Monospace-Is-Meaning Rule
rules.body: Monospace sets phone numbers, numeric counters, bracketed status codes ([OK], [ -- ]), and log lines. Prose, empty-state sentences, and questions always use sans-serif.

rules.name: The Press-Collapse Rule
rules.body: Every interactive shadowed control collapses its shadow on ACTION_DOWN and translates its surface by the shadow offset.

rules.name: The Flat-Container Rule
rules.body: Grouping containers (RetroPanel, the active tab, and ticket rows inside the panel) never cast a drop shadow.

dos: Do draw every UI element with Canvas and native Views using colors resolved exclusively from res/values/colors.xml.
Do size all text in sp (TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP) and keep every interactive touch target at least 48dp high.
Do use top horizontal semantic bands (and diagonal Canvas hatching on ungranted/empty states) across cards, tiles, and ticket rows.
Do keep the onboarding and main screen headers top-anchored at the same 20dp base padding + system-bar insets so transitions never jump.
Do wire native AccessibilityDelegate semantics (Button roles, headings, tab collections, and live state descriptions) on every custom view.
donts: Don't use kickers or // CODE eyebrows above headings.
Don't use colored left-border stripes on cards or list rows; use the horizontal top band instead.
Don't set prose or empty-state sentences in monospace, or phone numbers in sans-serif.
Don't round corners, add gradients/blur, or introduce third-party UI libraries.
